title: Compose a page from components
task: Create `SiteHeader` and `SiteFooter` components and render them from `App`. The header shows the site name as the page's main heading and a navigation landmark labelled "Main" with three links. The footer shows the copyright line.
hints: A component is a function with a capitalised name that returns JSX. Declare `SiteHeader` and `SiteFooter` next to `App`, then use them as tags: `<SiteHeader />`.
A `<nav>` element is a navigation landmark. Give it `aria-label="Main"` so assistive technology, and the tests, can tell it apart from other navigation.
`SiteHeader` returns a `<header>` holding an `<h1>` and a `<nav aria-label="Main">` with three `<a href="…">` links. `SiteFooter` returns a `<footer>` with the copyright text.
